title: Knowledge
subtitle: Writing, papers, algorithm practice, and AI industry observations.
viewAllDescription: Browse writing, notes, algorithm practice, and digests.

blob-article.title: Personal Blog Archive
blob-article.summary: A blog draft archive for AI productivity, cloud-native AI infrastructure, and engineering practice. It works as a long-running public writing base, with bilingual drafts, images, and topic-based organization that turn scattered experience into shareable material.
points: Organizes writing by topic, including AI productivity, engineering practice, and cloud-native AI infrastructure.
Keeps bilingual drafts and image assets so personal notes can grow into blog posts, Zhihu articles, or other public writing.
Turns tool usage, engineering judgment, and debugging experience into reusable references instead of one-off conversations.

paper-vault.title: Knowledge Vault
paper-vault.summary: A personal Obsidian knowledge base for systems and AI infrastructure, covering papers, technical concepts, and domain research reports.
points: Uses AI-assisted paper discovery and reading to build paper notes, indexed by topic, method, and scenario.
Organizes technical concepts and knowledge points, linking them to relevant papers and related notes through Obsidian’s internal links for easy reference.
Combines papers, technical concepts, and engineering practice in reports that compare approaches and trace research directions.

ai-builders-digest.title: AI Builders Digest
ai-builders-digest.summary: A daily and weekly digest of ideas, product moves, and signals from AI builders, maintained in Chinese, English, and bilingual versions. Rather than stacking news items, it compresses a high-frequency information stream into material that can be reviewed later.
points: Tracks signals from AI builders across social media, podcasts, and product releases, then packages them into daily and weekly digests.
Maintains Chinese, English, and bilingual versions for both quick reading and cross-language sharing.
Focuses on ideas, product moves, and trend shifts rather than isolated news items.

crater-insights.title: Crater Engineering Insights
crater-insights.summary: Engineering notes from work on RAIDS Lab Crater, covering architecture decisions, interface issues, and implementation trade-offs in CLI design, authentication, job management, and monitoring.
points: Records architecture decisions, interface issues, and the reasoning behind engineering trade-offs.
Covers accessibility, AI integration, CLI design, infrastructure, job management, and resource monitoring.
Uses diagrams and structured notes to explain authentication, component nesting, and implementation details.

oj-solutions.title: Algorithm Practice
oj-solutions.summary: A personal collection of algorithm practice and course solutions, including problems from LeetCode, Codeforces, and other platforms, with solution ideas, implementations, and optimization experiments.
points: Practices algorithms and data structures through solutions in C, C++, and Go.

Continues optimizing algorithms and implementations after acceptance, comparing custom data structures with STL and testing alternative implementations to measure runtime, memory use, and whether extra space improves speed.
Uses VS Code and command-line debuggers to set breakpoints, step through code, and inspect variables and call stacks to diagnose implementation issues.
Includes programming assignments from Data Structures (Year 1, spring) and Algorithm Analysis and Design (Year 2, fall).
